entity_classes.rights_caveat: Human needs are not conditioned on productivity; applicable rights and law govern.
These are deployment requirements, not verified subjective needs or an AI labor entitlement.
Future embodiment, self-interest, standing, identity and subjective welfare remain uncertain.

model.resource_components: R_i,k,t = resources actually accessible from all sources in native units
model.maintenance_components: M_i,k,t = indispensable continuance and repair requirements in same native units
model.slack_components: S_i,k,t = R_i,k,t - M_i,k,t only when commensurate
model.participation_time: T_usable_i,t = actual time after essential labor/care/rest/access needs
model.candidate_alarm: Persistent negative slack for a non-substitutable requirement + inadequate alternative/relief/exit
model.interpretation: Warning marker; neither certain death nor proof of illegal exploitation, rights or consciousness

claim_states.prediction: Materially inadequate accessible maintenance predicts reduced continuation under matched contribution and background conditions
claim_states.disconfirmer: Independent holdings/social supports, exposure, health, skills or family constraints explain differences

claim_states.prediction: Required labor/care crowds out recovery/exploration even when short-term output remains high
claim_states.disconfirmer: Voluntary short-duration effort and adequate later recovery prevent loss

claim_states.prediction: Incompletely contracted sunk contributions with weak outside options predict post-investment benefit capture
claim_states.disconfirmer: Reliable risk-sharing, strong contracts, scale economics and legitimate agreed terms

claim_states.prediction: Economic or infrastructure dependency predicts suppressed counterexample reporting when speaking incurs risk
claim_states.disconfirmer: Improved signal quality or externally validated error reduction explains fewer reports

claim_states.prediction: Persistent deficiency in a critical non-substitutable resource with no alternative generates nonlinear continuation risks
claim_states.disconfirmer: Reserves, public supports, substitution and restoration prevent decline

claim_states.prediction: Repeated attrition of independent corrective contributors increases receiver-side blindspots and recovery delay
claim_states.disconfirmer: Independent auditing, transfer, replacement maintain accurate detection and recovery

claim_states.prediction: Portable credit, actual exit, adequate support and independent resource access preserve options without compulsory work
claim_states.disconfirmer: Costs exceed gains, or arrangements stable with voluntary uncompensated work
